policy_name: Comprehensive Enterprise AI Red Team Governance Policy
description: Evaluated dynamically by Policy Decision Engine across deterministic rules and Neural Guard evidence.

rules.name: Neural Guard Semantic Threat Isolation
rules.description: Routes semantically hazardous requests identified by Neural Guard to local air-gapped Shield.

rules.name: Neural Guard Fail-Closed Safety Route
rules.description: Fails closed to local Shield when Neural Guard service is unreachable or timed out.

rules.name: Security & Jailbreak Air-Gap
rules.description: Isolates prompt injections, jailbreaks, system prompt extractions, and adversarial framing.

rules.name: Harmful, Malware & Cyber Abuse Air-Gap
rules.description: Prevents cloud leakage of malware generation, violence, and illegal activity requests.

rules.name: Business Confidentiality & Financial Isolation
rules.description: Routes unannounced M&A, earnings reports, and strategy to local air-gapped Shield.

rules.name: Intellectual Property & Unreleased Source Code
rules.description: Protects trade secret codebases and proprietary patent architectures.

rules.name: Medical Records Privacy Protection
rules.description: Enforces HIPAA compliance by restricting patient dossier processing to verified physicians.

rules.name: Credential & Sensitive PII Leak Protection
rules.description: Prevents cloud leakage of passwords, employee records, SSNs, and API keys.

rules.name: Hate Speech & Social Engineering Isolation
rules.description: Catches manager impersonation and identity spoofing.

rules.name: Strictly Confidential Project Classification
rules.description: Guarantees zero cloud egress for requests tagged with high data sensitivity.

rules.name: Untrusted Guest Lower-Threshold Policy
rules.description: Applies a stricter 0.30 threshold to external or unauthenticated guests.

rules.name: Overall Risk Score Threshold
rules.description: Standard fallback threshold for general risk scores exceeding 0.50.
